+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(t *testing.T) {
+	defaultVersion := semver.Version{Major: 1}
+	assert.Equal(t, defaultVersion, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(context.Background()))
+
+	version := semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}
+	ctx := WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(context.Background(), version)
+	assert.Equal(t, version, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+
+	overridden := semver.Version{Major: 3, Minor: 2, Patch: 1}
+	ctx = WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx, overridden)
+	assert.Equal(t, overridden, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+}
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		header string
+		want   semver.Version
+	}{
+		{name: "missing header", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "empty header", header: "", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "invalid header", header: "not-a-version", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "version with v prefix", header: "v1.2.3", want: semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}},
+		{name: "version without v prefix", header: "2.3.4", want: semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			if tt.name != "missing header" {
+				ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs("x-flipt-accept-server-version", tt.header))
+			}
+
+			called := false
+			response := &struct{}{}
+			handler := func(ctx context.Context, _ interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+				called = true
+				assert.Equal(t, tt.want, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+				return response, nil
+			}
+
+			got, err := FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(zaptest.NewLogger(t))(ctx, nil, nil, handler)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.True(t, called)
+			assert.Same(t, response, got)
+		})
+	}
+}

item.text:
Implemented gRPC handling for `x-flipt-accept-server-version`. The interceptor accepts versions with or without `v`, stores the parsed version in the request context, and uses `1.0.0` when the header is missing or invalid. It is registered in the server’s unary interceptor chain.

Two subagents handled the tests and server wiring; I reviewed the combined patch. The full middleware package tests and the existing `TestNewGRPCServer` test passed offline.
